note: Proxy keys are applied live by the addon. The AIMBOT / NATIVE and ESP / NATIVE groups are read by the injected dylib instead, and stay inert until that dylib is installed.

items.label: Quiet Mode
items.hint: Kill switch. Stops every modification, pure pass-through.

items.label: Capture Bodies
items.hint: Write request/response hex into the trace (bigger log, slower).

items.label: Block Telemetry
items.hint: Refuse analytics / metrics / crash-report hosts. Less upload traffic.

items.label: Block Ads
items.hint: Refuse ad-network hosts. Less bandwidth contention, fewer stalls.

items.label: Added Latency
items.hint: Delay applied to matching game traffic before it leaves the laptop.

items.label: Packet Drop
items.hint: Randomly refuse matching requests. Sharp tool - server will notice sustained use.

items.label: Config Overrides
items.hint: Enable the rewrite_json / pb_set rules in rules/freefire.yaml.

items.label: Suppress Maintenance
items.hint: Flip maintenance/closed flags in HTTP responses to open.

items.label: Mute Notices
items.hint: Blank announcement / notice payloads so popups stop.

items.label: Force Region
items.hint: Overwrite region strings in HTTP responses.

items.label: Hijack Webview
items.hint: Rewrite in-game webview/banner URLs to this menu. Requires rules/menu.yaml.

items.label: Menu Theme
items.hint: Cosmetic only, applies to this panel.

items.label: Hide From Recording
items.hint: Keeps the ESP overlay out of screen recordings and screenshots. Applied by the dylib, mirrored here so both panels agree.

groups.label: AIMBOT / NATIVE
groups.note: These keys are consumed by the injected dylib (native/). They do nothing until the modded IPA is installed.

items.label: Enable
items.hint: Lock onto the closest target to the crosshair.

items.label: Smooth
items.hint: Frames taken to close the gap. Higher = slower and less visible.

items.label: FOV
items.hint: Pixel radius around screen centre.

items.label: Target Bone
items.hint: Aim point height on the target.

items.label: On Screen Only
items.hint: Skip targets behind the camera.

groups.label: ESP / NATIVE
groups.note: Drawn by the dylib into its own overlay window above the render surface.

items.label: Enable
items.hint: Start the overlay.

items.label: Box
items.hint: Cornered bounding box.

items.label: Snapline
items.hint: Line from crosshair to target.

items.label: Name
items.hint: Player nickname above the box.

items.label: Health Bar
items.hint: Vertical bar left of the box.

items.label: Distance
items.hint: Metres.

items.label: FOV Circle
items.hint: Shows the aimbot radius.

items.label: Max Distance
items.hint: Cull players beyond this range.

items.label: Verbose Logs
items.hint: Write bind/resolve detail to Console.app. Off = silent, which is the default for a reason.

items.label: Verbose Trace
items.hint: Log every intercepted FF flow, not just the ones a rule matched.

items.label: Upstream Verify
items.hint: Off = accept any upstream certificate (ssl_insecure per-request).
